title: Making his reputation at Economy Hall with Manuel Perez's run
summary: Charles learned a difficult trumpet run of Perez's and played it at Economy Hall, spreading his name downtown.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: What about, say you're playing economy hall, Jean-Sami, Franz-Ami, all those halls, you played them?

That's where I made my reputation, Franz-Ami. Franz-Ami. Yeah. Jean-Sami I played that too. But Franz-Ami, that's where I made my reputation. Because they had that number that it was only Mangal Perez that could make that run on that instrument, on that trumpet. No others couldn't make it. And I heard Mangal made it one time, and right there I had it. And believe me, when I played in Mangal's place at the economy hall on Oyseline Street, I made that run, and those Creole downtown spread my name spread all over downtown. Oh, that man played just like Mangal, just like Mangal, that's Mangal. Everything Mangal can do, he can do. And Mangal was the star that he knew on. So that put me up on the top shelf.
